A slightly damaged iron sword, likely a defective product from the smelting process.
被反复回收与售卖的兵器，略带坑洼的剑刃早已没有当初锋利。
A weapon repeatedly recycled and resold, its pitted blade has long lost its former edge.
流传最久、随处可见的经典款式。
The most enduring and ubiquitous classic design.
采用了质量较好的铁冶炼的长剑。
A longsword forged from higher-quality iron.
钢制长剑，更加锋利。
A steel longsword with a keener edge.
与飞景剑、流采剑共称百辟宝剑，由某国太子命工匠精炼而成。
One of the Hundred-Refined Jeweled Swords along with Feijing and Liucai, commissioned by the crown prince of a certain state and crafted by master smiths.
多为边境少数民族所佩，剑身嵌有如松纹般脉络的装饰，故有此名
Commonly worn by frontier peoples, the blade bears pine-bark patterns, hence its name
流采剑色似采虹，与华锋剑、飞景剑共称百辟宝剑，由某国太子命工匠精炼而成。

Liucai Sword gleams like a rainbow. Together with the Huafeng and Feijing swords, it is counted among the Hundred-Refined Swords, forged by artisans at the command of a certain kingdom's crown prince.
蜀地工匠的杰作，多由蜀中精锐所佩戴。
A masterwork of Shu artisans, often carried by elite Shu soldiers.

One of the six swords cast by the Lord of Wu, intended as the most renowned sword within a hundred li, though far more ornamental than practical, as one of the six companion swords, it surely will not disappoint its wielder.

The Feijing Sword flashes like a meteor. Together with the Huafeng and Liucai Swords, it is renowned as one of the Hundred-Refined Jeweled Blades, forged by master craftsmen at the command of a crown prince.

One of six swords cast by the Lord of Wu. ‘Qingming’ evokes the vast azure sky, dragon-like patterns coil along its deep bluish blade, beloved by its owner.

c: Frost Iron ×1, Poplar Wood ×1, Fifty-Fold Steel ×4
tip: 吴首铸制六剑之一，铸以此剑辟邪斩魔，带有庇护剑主，镇其周围阴险之人之意。
One of six swords cast by the Lord of Wu, forged to ward off evil and slay demons, meant to protect its master and subdue those with sinister intent around him.
又名龙渊剑， 七星龙渊。相传欧冶子和干将铸此剑，凿茨山，放溪水，引至铸剑炉旁北斗七星环列的七个池中，名为七星。剑成之后，俯视剑身，如登高而下望渊，仿佛有巨龙盤卧，名为龙渊。故名此剑曰七星龙渊，简称龙渊剑。

Also known as the Dragon Abyss Sword, or Seven-Star Dragon Abyss. Legend says Ou Yezi and Gan Jiang forged this sword by piercing Mount Ci and channeling stream waters into seven pools arranged like the Big Dipper beside the forge, hence the name ‘Seven Stars.’ Upon its completion, gazing down upon the blade was like looking into a deep abyss from high above, as if a mighty dragon coiled within, hence the name ‘Dragon Abyss.’ Thus the sword was named Seven-Star Dragon Abyss, or simply the Dragon Abyss Sword.
雌雄双股剑之一， 季汉昭烈帝刘备之兵器。刘备举兵时命良匠以镔铁铸双剑，雌雄各一，雄剑长三尺九寸，雌剑长三尺六寸。明代《阵纪》所载：“卞庄子之纷击法，王聚之起落法，刘先主之顾应法，马明王之闪电法，马超之出手法，五家之剑有传。”

One of the Twin Swords, the weapon of Liu Bei, Emperor Zhaolie of Shu-Han. When raising his banner, Liu Bei ordered master craftsmen to forge twin swords from fine steel, one male and one female. The male sword was three chi nine cun long, and the female sword three chi six cun. As recorded in the Ming dynasty's ‘Records of Formations’: ‘The flurry strikes of Bian Zhuangzi, the rising and falling technique of Wang Ju, the guarding and responding technique of Former Sovereign Liu, the lightning technique of Ma Mingwang, and the drawing technique of Ma Chao—the swordsmanship of these five masters has been passed down.’
雌雄双股剑之一， 季汉昭烈帝刘备之兵器。刘备举兵时命良匠以镔铁铸双剑，雌雄各一，雄剑长三尺九寸，雌剑长三尺六寸。明代《阵纪》所载：“卞庄子之纷击法，王聚之起落法，刘先主之顾应法，马明王之闪电法，马超之出手法，五家之剑有传。”

One of the Twin Swords, the weapon of Emperor Zhaolie of Shu Han, Liu Bei. When raising his banner, Liu Bei ordered master smiths to forge twin swords from refined iron, one male and one female. The male sword was three feet nine inches long, and the female sword three feet six inches long. As recorded in the Ming dynasty's ‘Zhen Ji’: ‘The flurry strikes of Bian Zhuangzi, the rise-and-fall method of Wang Ju, the look-and-respond method of Former Sovereign Liu, the lightning method of Ma Mingwang, and the striking method of Ma Chao—the sword techniques of these five schools have been passed down.’

Forged for Yuan Shao after he dreamed in Liyang of a divine figure bestowing a sword named Sizhao. Upon waking, he had it forged and so named.

c: Hundred-Fold Steel ×3, Nanmu Wood ×1, Crude Steel ×5
tip: 吴首铸制六剑之一，此剑轻快锋利，舞动如流星，刺则似闪电，刀光剑影间速取敌将首级也。
One of the six swords cast by the Lord of Wu. Light and razor-sharp, it dances like a meteor and strikes like lightning, swiftly taking an enemy general's head amid flashing blades.

tip: 吴首铸制六剑之一，剑身光洁如白虹，闪烁寒光，令人难以近视。
One of six swords cast by the Lord of Wu. Its blade gleams pure white like a rainbow, radiating cold light that dazzles all who gaze upon it.

Named for Mount Jiankou, which it was meant to guard.

Pattern-Welded Steel ×1, Millennial Ironwood ×1, Frost Iron ×2, Red Sandalwood ×1
tip: 又叫尚方斩马剑，象征着权力，亦为正义的代表，重要场合得此剑同时也会受到隆重的授予仪式，也有贪官所畏惧该剑的公正正义象征一说。

Also known as the Shangfang Horse-Cleaving Sword, it symbolizes authority and represents justice. Bestowed in grand ceremonies on momentous occasions, it is also said to be feared by corrupt officials as an emblem of fairness and justice.

c: 陨铁×1、千年铁木×2、花纹钢×4、乌木×1
Meteoric Iron ×1, Millennial Ironwood ×2, Pattern-Welded Steel ×4, Ebony ×1

An imperial sword that cuts iron like mud, with the characters ‘Qinggang’ inlaid in gold on its hilt.

One of six swords cast by the Lord of Wu, its purple gleam flashes like lightning, dazzling and bitingly chill, three chi long, it has the characters ‘Zidian’ engraved on its hilt.

Forged alongside the Qinggang Sword, the two were hailed as peerless twin swords. Said to be named after the famous line ‘Draw the long sword and lean upon the heavens’ from the ‘Rhapsody on Great Words’. Only those destined for kingship can command its aura.
被反复回收与售卖的兵器，略带坑洼的刀刃早已没有当初锋利。
A weapon repeatedly recycled and resold, its pitted blade has long lost its former edge.
为满足临时需求而缩短了制刀工序，锋利度十分一般。
The saber-forging process was shortened to meet temporary demand, resulting in mediocre sharpness.

The most enduring and ubiquitous classic design.
采用了质量较好的铁锻造的大刀。
A Guandao forged from higher-quality iron.

Worn in pairs for ceremony or combat, a distinctive weapon of the Three Kingdoms era.
多为步兵持之，通常由钢铁反复折叠打制等工序处理制成的直刃长刀。
Commonly wielded by infantry, a straight-bladed long saber made by repeatedly folding and hammering steel.

Heavier and sharper than an ordinary saber, suited for those of great strength.
刀柄饰以豹头颅骨，此刀以祭礼制成，持有时身法如豹般灵动，并能号令豹群协同狩猎。
The hilt is adorned with a leopard skull. Crafted through sacrificial rites, this saber grants its wielder the agility of a leopard and the power to command packs of leopards to hunt alongside them.

c: Pattern-Welded Steel ×1, Hundred-Fold Steel ×2, Nanmu Wood ×3
tip: 刀镡取自象牙或象骨，此刀为降服象群首领所铸，持有时气势如山，可震慑并驱策象群冲锋。

Its guard is crafted from ivory or elephant bone. Forged to subdue the leader of an elephant herd, this saber grants an aura as imposing as a mountain when wielded, capable of awing elephant herds and driving them into a charge.
因其形状呈圆形，边缘处带突起尖刺，故称为日月刀。日月双刀常配套使用。
Named the Sun and Moon Saber for its circular shape with protruding spikes along the edge. Sun and Moon twin sabers are often used as a pair.
因其形状呈圆形，边缘处带突起尖刺，故称为日月刀。日月双刀常配套使用。
Named the Sun and Moon Saber for its circular shape and protruding spikes along the edge. Sun and Moon Twin Sabers are often used as a pair.
蜀中名匠蒲元所铸，锋利程度难以比及。
Forged by the renowned Shu craftsman Pu Yuan, its sharpness is beyond compare.
古锭刀轻快迅猛，适合多种角度出刀制敌，曾有武谚云“单刀看手、刀如猛虎”，在刀法精湛之人手中方能大放异彩。

Light and swift, the Guding Blade can strike from multiple angles to subdue foes. As the martial proverb goes, ‘Watch the free hand with a single saber, wield the saber like a fierce tiger.’ Only in the hands of a master of the saber can its brilliance truly shine.

Imperial Gold ×1, Millennial Ironwood ×1, Pattern-Welded Steel ×2, Ebony ×1

Measuring over a foot in length, this saber is adorned with seven inlaid jewels, from which it takes its name. A fine piece to admire indoors and sharp enough to cleave bone at close quarters, it is the premier choice for a personal saber.

A wrought-iron great saber of unknown weight, well suited for claiming the heads of enemy generals. Blood splatters to the vault of heaven, striking dread into hearts like fiery clouds.
为魏国太子曹丕造的三把宝刀的统称，三把刀都长四尺，重三斤左右，皆锋似霜。
The collective name for three treasured sabers crafted for Cao Pi, Crown Prince of Wei. All three were about four chi long, weighed roughly three jin, and had edges sharp as frost.
由邪马台工匠进行改良后的细刀。融合中日技法，招式以劈砍为主。其刀身狭长，攻守兼备，兼具日本刀的速度与中华武术的沉稳。

A slender saber modified by Yamatai craftsmen. Blending Chinese and Japanese techniques, its forms focus primarily on slashing. Its long, narrow blade serves well in both offense and defense, combining the speed of a Japanese blade with the composure of Chinese martial arts.

c: Black Iron ×5, Hundred-Fold Steel ×2, Nanmu Wood ×2
tip: 典韦双铁戟之一，左手戟重三十九斤，右手戟重四十一斤。铁戟双提八十斤，威风凛凛震乾坤！
One of Dian Wei's Twin Bladed Halberds. The left weighs thirty-nine jin, the right forty-one. With eighty jin of twin halberds in hand, his awe-inspiring might shakes heaven and earth!
典韦双铁戟之一，左手戟重三十九斤，右手戟重四十一斤。铁戟双提八十斤，威风凛凛震乾坤！
One of Dian Wei's twin iron halberds. The left weighs thirty-nine jin, the right forty-one. Twin iron halberds raised, eighty jin in hand—an awe-inspiring might that shakes heaven and earth!

c: Pattern-Welded Steel ×3, Hundred-Fold Steel ×1, Nanmu Wood ×1
tip: 甘宁“慨锐双戟”之一，戟刃弧度如新月，背刻巴蜀夔纹，铭记其“豪侠轻死”的本色与“百骑劫魏营”的慷慨壮举。此戟杀气最盛，亦最恣意洒脱。

One of Gan Ning's ‘Bold-Edge Twin Halberds’. Its blade curves like a crescent moon, its spine carved with Bashu kui patterns, commemorating his true nature as ‘a gallant defying death’ and the heroic feat of ‘raiding the Wei camp with a hundred horsemen’. This halberd possesses the fiercest murderous aura, yet remains the most untamed and unrestrained.
甘宁“慨锐双戟”之一，戟环改制自锦帆铜铃，挥动时清音摄敌，映其“闻铃破胆”的战场威慑。此戟代表其疾如流火的奇袭之道。

One of Gan Ning's ‘Bold-Edge Twin Halberds’, its ring refashioned from a brocade-sail bronze bell to ring clear and intimidate foes when swung, reflecting his battlefield terror of ‘striking fear at the sound of the bell’. This halberd embodies his art of surprise raids, swift as flowing fire.

c: Imperial Gold ×1, Red Sandalwood ×1, Meteoric Iron ×2
tip: 曾有人用此刀随孙权讨黄祖与蒙冲河，其引刀断流为二头，士卒得以前进追击，震惊四众，故称其刀为断蒙。

Someone once wielded this saber following Sun Quan to campaign against Huang Zu at the Mengchong River. Drawing the saber, he cleaved the flow into two, allowing the troops to advance in pursuit. Astounding all who witnessed it, the saber was thus called ‘Duanmeng’.

c: 陨铁×1、千年铁木×1、寒铁×4、紫檀木×2
Meteoric Iron ×1, Millennial Ironwood ×1, Frost Iron ×4, Red Sandalwood ×2
tip: 为魏国太子曹丕所造，用以携身防身最佳，亦可显自身威严，便以治人。
Forged for Crown Prince Cao Pi of Wei, ideal for personal defense and projecting authority to better govern the people.

tip: 南朝陶弘景所著《古今刀剑录》所载，记载董卓少时耕作获得无铭刀，刀身四面隐现山云纹，经蔡邕鉴定为项羽佩刀。在项羽参与的巨鹿之战、彭城之战等重大战役中均有使用记载。

According to the ‘Record of Ancient and Modern Sabers and Swords’ by Tao Hongjing of the Southern Dynasties, Dong Zhuo found an unmarked saber while plowing in his youth. Faint mountain-and-cloud patterns were visible on all four sides of the blade, and Cai Yong identified it as Xiang Yu's personal saber. Records show it was used in major battles fought by Xiang Yu, such as the Battle of Julu and the Battle of Pengcheng.

Crafted during the founding of the Western Han by several lords of different surnames, it incorporated the forging techniques of the Miao saber and was later buried underground as a funerary good. Legend says the saber continually absorbed yin energy from corpses underground, if wielded by someone whose vitality falls short of fierce valor, they will suffer its backlash. Hence, it is also known as the Evil Saber or Demonic Saber.
由战场上回收下来的长刀，或许还能派上些用场。
A long saber salvaged from the battlefield. It might still prove useful.
百姓家中常见的工具，即可处理农务也可防身。
A common household tool, useful for both farm work and self-defense.
早已生锈的铁戟，恐怕难以派上用场。
A thoroughly rusted iron halberd, hardly fit for service.
斧刃略带卷边，但斧头重量还在。
The axe edge is slightly curled, but the head still carries its weight.
马上作战最常见的兵器之一，比长枪与戟略重一些。
One of the most common mounted weapons, slightly heavier than spears and halberds.
相较于普通长戟更为沉重，虽说略微增加了伤害，但也更难防御。
Heavier than an ordinary halberd, while it slightly increases damage, defending with it is also more difficult.
相较于常见斧头要更加沉重，若能挥起此斧，便能造成更多的伤害。
Heavier than a common axe, those who can swing it deal greater damage.
将刀柄改为铁制，增加了刀身重量同时也增加了劈砍强度。
Replacing the hilt with iron adds weight to the blade while also increasing chopping power.
马上作战中可以见到的兵器之一，挥砍起来力量惊人。
A weapon seen in mounted combat, delivering terrifying force when swung.
精炼钢材打造，刀刃的锋利程度远超普通铁刀。
Forged from refined steel, its edge far surpasses that of an ordinary iron saber.
斧柄更长，在战场上可以攻击到更远敌人。
A longer haft allows attacking enemies at greater range on the battlefield.

tip: 对斧尾进行了做尖、做弯处理，可以进行更多种类的进攻。
The axe butt has been sharpened and curved, enabling more varied attacks.
以铁铸成的巨大长柄斧，如果不是力大无穷的人则难以发挥其威力，被力大者使其击中则根骨具裂，难以生还
A massive iron poleaxe whose full might can only be unleashed by someone of immense strength, a blow struck by such a wielder shatters every bone, leaving no hope of survival

c: Frost Iron ×2, Poplar Wood ×1, Crude Steel ×3

A long saber with a sharp hook at the tip, capable of easily dragging enemy generals from their horses for the kill, or striking enemies from unexpected angles
重五十斤有余，刀身有三个刀尖，刀刃两面开锋，可在人群中突围出一条路来。
Weighing over fifty jin with three blade points and edges on both sides, it can carve a path through crowds.

c: Mithril ×1, Red Sandalwood ×1, Meteoric Iron ×1, Nanmu Wood ×1
tip: 原本是作为镇压鬼神的镇宅用品，后来也出现在了战场上。
Originally a household charm to ward off evil spirits, it eventually found its way onto the battlefield.

c: Imperial Gold ×2, Ebony ×1, Frost Iron ×1, Red Sandalwood ×1
tip: 长柄斧，斧头斧刃皆做镀金装饰，见其斧便可感受到铸者的骄奢之气。
A poleaxe with gilded head and blade, exuding the extravagance of its maker.

c: Fifty-Fold Steel ×1, Nanmu Wood ×1, Hundred-Fold Steel ×5
tip: 比常见的普通大刀稍短，但是刀背则是普通大刀的几倍厚，需要使用者有较大臂力。
Shorter than an ordinary great blade but several times thicker at the spine, requiring considerable arm strength.

c: Imperial Gold ×2, Nanmu Wood ×1, Pattern-Welded Steel ×3, Ebony ×4

The crescent blade is broad and long, shaped like a half-moon, with a spur on the spine and a hole pierced to hang a tassel. Where the blade meets the shaft sits a dragon-mouth fitting, and the butt ends in an iron ferrule. It is also known as the Cold Splendor Saw.
在戈的头部装至矛尖便称之为戟，即可钩也可刺砍。
Attaching a spear tip to a dagger-axe creates a halberd capable of hooking, thrusting, and slashing.
马上作战最常见的兵器之一，劈砍逊于长刀、刺击逊于长枪，所以适合混合招式。
One of the most common mounted weapons, inferior to long sabers in chopping and spears in thrusting, making it well-suited for mixed techniques.
采用了质量较好的铁锻造的长戟，攻防兼备。
A long halberd forged from quality iron, balanced for both offense and defense.
经由特殊处理的钢锻制的长戟，更容易进行防御。
A long halberd forged from specially treated steel, making it easier to defend.
相传由吴郡一代著名铁匠锻造，在江南一带较为常见。
Reputedly forged by a famous smith from the Wu Commandery, commonly seen in the Jiangnan region.
戟与柄之间带有青龙纹饰的长戟，多受各地豪杰青睐。
A long halberd with an azure dragon design between blade and shaft, favored by heroes across the land.
长柄较为柔韧，在战场技艺熟练之人的手中可以发挥出惊人的效果。
Its flexible shaft lets a skilled warrior unleash astonishing techniques on the battlefield.

c: Pattern-Welded Steel ×2, Nanmu Wood ×1, Crude Steel ×3
tip: 构造独特的长戟，除了砍与刺，在钩与横扫方面也有优异的表现。
A uniquely designed halberd excelling not only at chopping and thrusting but also at hooking and sweeping.
又沉又重的长戟，并非一般人所能驾驭的兵器。
A heavy halberd beyond the strength of ordinary warriors to wield.

A long halberd with winged ornaments at the butt, favored by heroes across the land.

Decorated with colorful paintings along its shaft, it is also known as the Painted-Shaft Sky Piercer. The halberd's tip forms a grid shape, mostly serving as an ornamental piece for ceremonies, though wielding it in battle demands extraordinary strength and skill.
简易木材和铁器制成的枪，不知是否耐用。
A spear made from simple lumber and iron, though its durability is uncertain.
由木柄和铁槊头组成，可在马上进攻使用。
Composed of a wooden shaft and iron lance head, suitable for mounted attacks.

Produced with a shortened forging process to meet temporary needs, resulting in mediocre sharpness.
流传最久、随处可见的经典款式。
The most enduring and ubiquitous classic design.
用较为稀有的玄铁锻制而成，可刺穿厚重的铠甲。
Forged from rare dark iron, capable of piercing heavy armor.
枪尖分为了三刃，提升了杀伤力。
A three-edged spear tip that increases lethality.
将长槊的槊头替换为钢制槊头，提升了锋利程度。
Replacing the lance head with a steel one improves its sharpness.
蛇矛的一种，由铁制成，比普通蛇矛稍重，矛两面皆有利刃。
A type of serpentine spear made of iron, slightly heavier than normal, with edges on both sides.
多为枪兵持之的普通长枪，非常适合用枪的长度优势来攻击敌军。
A common spear mostly wielded by spearmen, ideal for exploiting the weapon's reach advantage to attack enemies.

Though made of bamboo, it is surprisingly sturdy and durable.
为马上作战专制的长槊。
A long lance specially designed for mounted combat.

A pure steel lance capable of thrusting, throwing, and sweeping.

Extraordinarily sharp and effective at piercing armor, though seemingly not very durable.
改良版的透甲枪，由于锻造材料难寻，故价格不菲。
An improved armor-piercing spear, rare forging materials make it quite costly.
据传是根据一名流浪工匠留传的最为得意的作品图纸所仿制，深受豪杰侠士喜爱。

Imperial Gold ×1, Nanmu Wood ×1, Meteoric Iron ×1, Millennial Ironwood ×1

A lance with a shaft of special wood, more flexible than standard lances and possessing impressive piercing power.

Its body is forged from refined iron, with a shaft one zhang long and a golden spearhead two chi one cun. With a gilded tip clasped in a gilded tiger-mouth fitting, it is incomparably sharp, cleaving wolves and slaying rebels.

c: 紫金×1、楠木×1、寒铁×3、千年铁木×2
Imperial Gold ×1, Nanmu Wood ×1, Frost Iron ×3, Millennial Ironwood ×2
tip: 用镔铁锻造，矛杆长一丈，矛尖长八寸，矛尖点钢即破，锋利无比，因此又名丈八点钢矛。
Forged from fine steel, with a ten-foot shaft and an eight-inch tip that pierces steel on contact, it is incomparably sharp—hence it is also known as the Ten-Foot-Eight Pointed Steel Spear.

c: 寒铁×1、乌木×1、花纹钢×4、千年铁木×3
Frost Iron ×1, Ebony ×1, Pattern-Welded Steel ×4, Millennial Ironwood ×3
tip: 又名涯角、龙胆亮银枪，枪身如龙、枪尖如虹，若勇猛之士持之，则深陷万军之中亦可所向披靡、无人能挡。

Also called the Yajiao Spear or Dragon Courage Silver Spear. Its shaft coils like a dragon and its tip arcs like a rainbow. In the hands of a brave warrior, it is unstoppable even amid ten thousand foes.
远程攻击最常见的手段。
The most common means of ranged attack.
小巧的弓，便与携带。
A compact bow, easy to carry.
弓身更长，射程与杀伤力也略有增强。
A longer bow with slightly improved range and power.
弓身一半以上为铁制，为重型弓，需要携带指环来保护手指才得以使用。
More than half iron, this heavy bow requires a finger guard to draw.
全名铜胎铁背弓，为重型弓，几乎为纯铁打造，对使用者要求较高。
Known in full as the Copper-Core Iron-Backed Bow, this heavy bow is forged almost entirely from iron and demands great strength from its user.
由传说中的著名谋士发明，一次可发十支箭，火力强劲，但由于其体积重量大，很难携带使用，主要用来防守城墙阵地。
Invented by a legendary strategist, it can fire ten bolts at once with tremendous power, but due to its great size and weight, it is difficult to carry and is primarily used to defend wall positions.
带有一些装饰的弓，通常不会出现在战场上。
A decorated bow, typically not seen on the battlefield.
用金银珠宝等宝物装饰，有瑰丽的花纹雕于弓身，同为适合赏玩游猎等活动适用。
Adorned with gold, silver, and gems, with magnificent patterns carved along the bow, well-suited for appreciation and leisurely hunts.
由西北特殊技艺制成的大弓，重型弓，多为豪杰使用，对使用者要求较高。
A large, heavy bow crafted with special northwestern techniques, favored by heroes and demanding much of its wielder.
又叫做麒麟弓，用老虎的筋作为弓弦，可轻易射到一百五十步的距离，曾有人用此弓辕门射戟，远近闻名。
Also known as the Qilin Bow, strung with tiger sinew, it can easily reach a distance of one hundred and fifty paces. Once used to shoot the halberd at the camp gate, earning renown far and wide.
又称铁节鞭，常见的打击武器，近距离作战威力较大。
Also called an iron-jointed whip, a common striking weapon with great close-range power.

c: Crude Steel ×1, Nanmu Wood ×2, Fifty-Fold Steel ×3
tip: 钢制节鞭，击马腿可将骑者击倒在地，同铁鞭一样，适合进行牵制攻击。
A steel-jointed whip. A strike to a horse's legs unseats the rider, like an iron whip, it is ideal for harassing attacks.
黄盖的一对竹节钢鞭，鞭身呈竹节状，共十三节，寓意忠节俱全。通体以百炼精钢为主材。劲竹、钢骨二鞭合璧，便是“刚柔并济，忠韧双全”。后世匠人与史家据其生平风骨，推演复原，终得“劲竹”、“钢骨”二鞭之名。

Huang Gai's pair of bamboo-jointed steel whips, shaped like bamboo stalks with thirteen segments to symbolize complete loyalty and integrity. Forged predominantly from hundred-fold refined steel, the two whips together—‘Firm Bamboo’ and ‘Steel Bone’—embody ‘the harmony of strength and suppleness, the perfection of loyalty and resilience.’ Later craftsmen and historians reconstructed them based on his life and character, ultimately bestowing upon the two whips the names ‘Firm Bamboo’ and ‘Steel Bone’.
黄盖的一对竹节钢鞭，鞭身呈竹节状，共十三节，寓意忠节俱全。通体以百炼精钢为主材。劲竹、钢骨二鞭合璧，便是“刚柔并济，忠韧双全”。后世匠人与史家据其生平风骨，推演复原，终得“劲竹”、“钢骨”二鞭之名。

Huang Gai's pair of bamboo-jointed steel whips. Shaped like bamboo segments, thirteen in all, they symbolize complete loyalty and integrity. Forged primarily from hundred-refined steel, the two whips—‘Sturdy Bamboo’ and ‘Steel Bone’—embody being ‘firm yet yielding, loyal and resilient.’ Later craftsmen and historians reconstructed them based on his character and deeds, ultimately giving the two whips the names ‘Sturdy Bamboo’ and ‘Steel Bone’.
长而无刃，有四棱，虽与铁鞭同为鞭类兵器，但铁锏的分量较为沉重。
Long, edgeless, and four-ridged. Though in the same family as iron whips, iron maces are considerably heavier.
经由特殊处理的钢锻制的鞭，更容易进行防御。
A mace forged from specially treated steel, making Defense easier.

c: Frost Iron ×2, Poplar Wood ×1, Crude Steel ×4
tip: 圆柱型的铁锏，据传为中原铁匠最爱的款式。
A cylindrical iron mace, said to be the favorite design of Central Plains smiths.
木制的鞭，威力一般。
A wooden whip with ordinary power.
鉴于锏与鞭之间的风格，打击伤害效果拔群。
Bridging the styles of maces and whips, it excels at impact damage.
形状独特的铁鞭，每一节呈八角形，据传此类武器源于某个教派。
A distinctively shaped iron whip with octagonal segments, said to originate from a certain sect.

锤头上布满了铁刺，进攻时更具杀伤力。
The hammerhead is covered in iron spikes, making it even more lethal on the attack.
常见的大锤。
A common war hammer.
相传始皇帝曾于博浪沙被名将使锤奇袭，博浪一名从此流传开来。
Legend says the First Emperor was ambushed at Bolangsha by a famed hammer-wielding warrior, and the name Bolang has been passed down ever since.
乌黑沉重的铁锤。
A dark, heavy iron hammer.
锤头为方形，拥有十足的锤击伤害，但由于十分笨重故不便移动。
A square hammer head dealing tremendous impact damage, but too cumbersome for agile movement.
木制的锤头，伤害一般。
A wooden hammer head with ordinary damage.
外观似瓜，又名金瓜锤。
Shaped like a melon, also called the Golden Melon Hammer.
最简易的木简，由长短不一的木片与细绳构成，可供文人使用。

用于记录和传递信息的木简，官府中随处可见。
Wooden slips for recording and transmitting information, commonly found in the Government.
由经过处理与精心挑选的木片制成的小型木简，多用来记载珍贵重要的内容。
A compact set of carefully selected and treated wood slips, used for recording precious and important content.
与木简一样用来记载文字的竹简，竹简在南方更为常见。
Bamboo slips used for writing like wooden slips, more common in the south.
为才能杰出之人准备的小型简。
A compact set of slips prepared for persons of outstanding talent.
小巧高贵的竹简，颇受南方文人墨客的欢迎。
A compact, elegant bamboo slip favored by southern scholars and literati.
轻薄但很长的竹简，可以记载更多的内容，适合研习之人。
Thin but long bamboo slips that hold more content, suitable for studious individuals.

Millennial Ironwood ×1, Imperial Silk ×1, Red Sandalwood ×3, Shu Brocade ×1

Compact bamboo slips named after someone renowned for benevolence and righteousness, perhaps able to rouse one's potential.

Millennial Ironwood ×1, Imperial Silk ×1, Red Sandalwood ×5, Wu Brocade ×1

Bamboo scrolls specifically for recording astrology, calendrics, and arcane arts, suited for erudite scholars.

随处可见的用飞禽羽翼制成扇子。
A common fan made from bird feathers.

The feathers are damaged but still functional.
带有粉色花瓣图样的羽扇，深受女性喜爱。
A feather fan with pink petal designs, popular among women.
为才能杰出之人准备的小型羽扇。
A compact feather fan prepared for persons of outstanding talent.
在战场上用来传递指令的小型羽扇，多为军师与祭酒使用。
A small feather fan used to relay commands on the battlefield, typically used by strategists and libationers.
洁白的羽扇，用来提醒自己最合适不过。
A pristine white feather fan, perfect for reminding oneself to stay composed.
带有深红羽毛的扇子，或许象征着权贵。
A fan with deep crimson feathers, perhaps symbolizing noble status.

tip: 外部洁白的羽扇，或许更容易使人冷静下来。
A white feather fan that may help its user maintain composure.

A feather fan crafted from the tail feathers of an unknown rare bird, extremely uncommon.

tip: 由兽毛或棉、麻制成的器具，偶尔在不同门派的学士手中可以见到。
A tool made from animal hair or cotton and hemp fiber, occasionally seen in the hands of scholars from various schools.

tip: 采用特殊兽毛制成的拂尘，多为方术士使用。
A fly-whisk made from special animal hair, commonly used by mystics and diviners.
有着古老渊源的乐器，在宫中与乐府较为常见。
An ancient instrument with deep historical roots, commonly found in the palace and the Bureau of Music.
与琴同为常见的弦乐。
A stringed instrument as common as the qin.
标准的木琴，十分耐用。
A standard wooden qin, highly durable.
采用罕见的软木制作的琴，音色更加动听。
A qin made from rare softwood with a more melodious tone.
相传舜定琴为五弦，文王增一弦，武王伐纣又增一弦，最终为七弦。
Legend says Shun established the qin with five strings, King Wen added one, and King Wu added another during his campaign against King Zhou, resulting in seven strings.
精致的礼琴，通常作为贵重之物赠予他人。
An exquisite ceremonial qin, typically given as a precious gift.
据传为最古老的琴。
Said to be the oldest qin in existence.
玉琴并非是由玉制成，而是对声音调教完美的琴的统称。
The Jade Qin is not made of jade, but is rather a general term for any qin whose tone has been tuned to perfection.
由南方传奇乐师特制的琴，名为绕梁。
A qin specially crafted by a legendary southern musician, named Raoliang.

tip: 吴人有烧桐以爨者，邕闻火烈之声。知其良木，因请而裁为琴，果有美音，而其尾犹焦，故时人名曰焦尾琴焉。

A man of Wu was burning paulownia for fuel when Cai Yong heard the fire's crackling and recognized fine wood. He asked for it and had it fashioned into a qin of beautiful tone, but its tail remained scorched, so people of the time named it the ‘Scorched-Tail Qin’.
雕有兽首的木杖，多为方术士做法使用。
A wooden staff carved with a beast head, typically used by mystics for ritual purposes.

c: Imperial Gold ×1, Nanmu Wood ×1, Mithril ×1, Red Sandalwood ×2
tip: 造型奇特的木杖，据传可以呼风唤雨。
A staff of unusual design, said to be able to summon wind and rain.

Imperial Gold ×1, Meteoric Iron ×1, Ebony ×4, Fifty-Fold Steel ×3
tip: 此刀系钟会攻伐蜀汉时在成都所得，刀身刻有“太一”铭文。据考证此刀并非三国时代所铸，推测在更早时期被埋藏于成都地下。

This saber was obtained by Zhong Hui in Chengdu during his campaign against Shu Han, bearing the inscription ‘Taiyi’ upon its blade. Studies indicate that it was not forged during the Three Kingdoms period, but had been buried beneath Chengdu in a much earlier era.
未经仔细打磨便被带上战场的铁盾。
An iron shield sent to the battlefield with barely any polishing.
最古早的盾牌之一，时至今日也非常实用。
One of the oldest shield designs, still highly practical to this day.
由经过处理的硬木与铁组成，虽然牺牲了一定防御力，但比普通的盾牌轻便了许多。
Made of treated hardwood and iron. Though it sacrifices some defense, it is far lighter than an ordinary shield.
铁制的圆盾，可有效抵挡汇聚一点的冲击。
A round iron shield, effective at deflecting focused impacts.
形状奇异的铁制小盾，上下带有长长的弯钩，十分方便招架与反击。
An oddly shaped small iron shield with long curved hooks on top and bottom, convenient for parrying and countering.
整体为方形盾，左右两边为极具辨识的弧线，又名盾，最早为始皇帝部队所配备.
A square shield with distinctive curved edges on both sides. First issued to the armies of the First Emperor.
加以装饰的弧纹盾，多为战场统领所持。
A decorated arc-pattern shield, typically carried by battlefield commanders.
加以装饰的弧纹盾，多为战场统领所持。
A decorated arc-pattern shield, typically carried by battlefield commanders.
在盾牌表面留有一圈铁铆的盾牌，较为常见。
A shield with a ring of iron rivets on its surface, fairly common.

A shield with a ring of iron rivets on its surface, fairly common.
西南蛮族用藤条编织的盾，防御性能不弱于常规铁盾，但十分怕火。
A shield woven from rattan by southwestern tribal peoples. Its defensive capability rivals ordinary iron shields, but it is highly vulnerable to fire.
在盾牌表面带有狮首的圆盾。
A round shield bearing a lion-head emblem on its surface.
将钩镶两头的铁钩改为了锋利的弯刃，适合悍勇之人。
A hook shield with the iron hooks at both ends replaced by sharp curved blades, suited for fierce warriors.
活跃于西南一带的蛮族部落特制的简易护甲，无法保护上半身。
Simple armor crafted by tribal clans of the southwest, unable to protect the upper body.
活跃于西南一带的蛮族部落特制的简易护甲，无法保护上半身。
Simple armor crafted by tribal clans of the southwest, unable to protect the upper body.

c: Pattern-Welded Steel ×1, Kudzu Cloth ×1, Hundred-Fold Steel ×3

An Artifact with the 【Recover [Large]】 Command Spirit (recovers 2% Wounded per second when the unit is out of combat). A ring-shaped jade with a cord loop, symbolizing safe return and warding off calamity.
附带【破坏】军魂（破坏力提高15%）的宝物。原本是便于拉动弓弦指环，但稍加装饰也可赋予意义。
An Artifact imbued with the 【Demolish】 Command Spirit (Siege Damage increased by 15%). Originally a ring to help draw bowstrings, but with a touch of decoration it can also carry special meaning.
附带【破坏[大]】军魂（破坏力提高33%）的宝物。雕有兽首的扳指，给予佩戴者威严感。
An artifact imbued with the 【Demolish [Large]】 Command Spirit (+33% Siege Damage). A thumb ring carved with a beast's head, granting the wearer an air of authority.
附带【增速】军魂（移动速度提高15%）的宝物。装有香料的护符袋，祈祷携带之人尽早离开战场。
An artifact with the 【Swiftness】 Command Spirit (Move Speed increased by 15%). A charm pouch filled with spices, praying that its bearer leaves the battlefield as soon as possible.
附带【增速[大]】军魂（移动速度提高33%）的宝物。刺有锦绣的护符袋，祈祷携带之人尽早离开战场。
An artifact with the 【Swiftness [L]】 Command Spirit (increases Move Speed by 33%). An embroidered charm pouch, praying its bearer leaves the battlefield soon.
附带【固防】军魂（防御提高10%）的宝物。玉质呈灰青色，看起来结实有防护性的玉璧。
An artifact with the 【Fortify】 Command Spirit (increases Defense by 10%). A grayish-blue jade disc that looks solid and protective.
附带【固防[大]】军魂（防御提高22%）的宝物。玉质呈青白色，璧内雕有首尾相对的两条龙，身躯刚劲，形态回环有力。
An artifact imbued with the 【Fortify [L]】 Command Spirit (Defense +22%). A bluish-white jade disc carved with two dragons facing head to tail, their bodies coiled with vigorous grace.
附带【强攻】军魂（攻击提高10%）的宝物。玉石雕刻护符，有着辟邪消灾的寓意。
An artifact imbued with the 【Assault】 Command Spirit (Attack increased by 10%). A talisman carved from jade, symbolizing the warding off of evil and disaster.
附带【强攻[大]】军魂（攻击提高22%）的宝物。外观华丽的精致玉佩。用复杂的通透雕刻法雕制，具有动态与威严感。
An artifact with the 【Assault [L]】 Command Spirit (+22% Attack). An ornate jade pendant of elaborate openwork carving, radiating dynamism and majesty.
附带【反伤】军魂（反弹7%的伤害）的宝物。虽说是民间常见常见的铜镜，但也能当作平安的信物。
An artifact with the 【Damage Reflect】 Command Spirit (reflects 7% damage). Though an ordinary bronze mirror common among the folk, it also serves as a token of safe passage.
附带【反伤[大]】军魂（反弹15%的伤害）的宝物。来自北方工匠的杰作，可以让佩戴者感受到凤鸟的威严。
An artifact with the 【Damage Reflect [Major]】 Command Spirit (reflects 15% damage). A masterwork of northern craftsmen, allowing the wearer to feel the majesty of the phoenix.
附带【生擒】军魂（俘虏敌人的概率提升20%）的宝物。最早由中原远近闻名的年轻祭酒所绘，从军中流传出来后被无数人临摹收藏。

An artifact imbued with the 【Capture】 Command Spirit (+20% chance to capture enemies). Originally painted by a famed young Libationer of Zhongyuan, it was endlessly copied and collected after circulating from the army.
附带【生擒[大]】军魂（俘虏敌人的概率提升45%）的宝物。为传奇中原将领之后绘制，气势磅礴的黄河跃然于纸上。

An Artifact imbued with the 【Capture [Large]】 Command Spirit (+45% chance to capture enemies). Painted for the descendant of a legendary Zhongyuan general, the majestic Yellow River leaps off the paper.
附带【远射】军魂（弓兵射程提升15%）的宝物。给予弓手信念的护身符，保佑自己百步穿杨。
An artifact with the 【Long Range】 Command Spirit (Archer Range +15%). A talisman giving archers faith, blessing them to hit the mark at a hundred paces.
附带【远射[大]】军魂（弓兵射程提升33%）的宝物。采用了罕见的鸟禽尾羽，在阳光下可折射出不同的颜色。
An artifact endowed with the 【Long Range [Large]】 Command Spirit (Archer Range +33%). Crafted from rare bird tail feathers that refract different colors in sunlight.
附带【浴火】军魂（减少火焰伤害25%）的宝物。通常镶嵌在胸甲上，但也可通过其他方式单独穿戴。
An artifact imbued with the 【Bathed in Fire】 Command Spirit (-25% fire damage). Usually inlaid into a cuirass, but it can also be worn separately through other means.
附带【浴火[大]】军魂（减少火焰伤害55%）的宝物。带有华丽纹饰的护心镜。
An artifact with the 【Fireproof [L]】 Command Spirit (reduces Fire damage by 55%). A heart-guard mirror with ornate patterning.
附带【大坚壁之阵】军魂（每当改变阵法时，自身防御力提升30%）。螭虎盘踞，金络补天。方寸之间，烙印着「受命于天，既寿永昌」的八篆血誓。执此玺者，其军阵变动如龙行九霄。

Imbued with the 【Grand Fortress Formation】 Command Spirit (Defense increases by 30% whenever changing Formation). Coiled with a dragon and mended with gold, within its small square it bears the eight seal-script characters of the blood oath: ‘Having received the Mandate of Heaven, may he lead a long and prosperous life.’ Whoever holds this seal shifts formations like a dragon soaring through the nine heavens.
附带【恢复[大]】军魂（部队在非交战状态时, 每秒恢复2%的伤兵）的宝物。带有绳扣的环形玉石，有祛邪免灾、归去平安的寓意。

An Artifact imbued with the 【Recover [Large]】 Command Spirit (when the unit is out of combat, recovers 2% Wounded per second). A circular Jade with a cord clasp, symbolizing the warding off of evil and returning safely.
战场上必不可少的身影。
An indispensable presence on the battlefield.
西部产战马，适应性强，常见于西凉骑兵部队。
A warhorse bred in the western regions, highly adaptable, commonly seen in Xiliang cavalry units.
曾为某叛将的坐骑，后经数人之手，但其主多遭不幸，故传出了的卢妨主的说法。但亦有的卢曾为其主脱离险境的传闻，曾有目睹者称见的卢从水中跃起三丈高助其主脱险而去，因此的卢生天地间，遂不可被人轻易驾驭的说法愈加被世人信服。

Once the mount of a rebel general, it passed through many hands, but most of its owners met with misfortune, giving rise to the saying, ‘Hexmark dooms its master.’ Yet rumors also tell of Hexmark rescuing its master from dire peril, with eyewitnesses claiming to have seen it leap three zhang from the water to carry its lord to safety. Thus, the world grew all the more convinced that Hexmark, born between heaven and earth, was never to be easily mastered.
赤兔胭脂兽，当下名马之首，体力稍小但速度快奈疲劳，性烈，难易主，所见之人无不称羡。因其鼻骨稍向前突出，马耳略长，毛色呈枣骝色，故称之为赤兔马。

The Red Hare Rouge Beast, foremost among the famed steeds of the era. Though its stamina is somewhat limited, it possesses blazing speed and endures fatigue well, fiery of temperament and reluctant to accept a new master, it is admired by all who behold it. Because its nasal bone protrudes slightly, its ears are somewhat long, and its coat is chestnut bay, it is known as the Red Hare.
因此马飞奔迅猛，其影子都难以跟上，于是便叫做绝影。虽然命名中抱有其主美好的希冀，但绝影也未让其失望，有伯乐称此马为汗血宝马，更有其者目睹此马身中三箭仍能奋蹄疾驰，扬尘而去。

This steed ran so swiftly that even its own shadow could not keep pace, hence its name, Shadow Runner. Though the name carried its master's high hopes, Shadow Runner never disappointed. Connoisseurs acclaimed it as a blood-sweating steed, and some even witnessed it gallop furiously after taking three arrows, speeding away in a cloud of dust.
马身煞白，四蹄皆呈淡黄色，气质非凡贵雅，形态庄严磅礴，唯有王相外露之人才可配得此马为骑。
A stark white coat with four pale yellow hooves, an exceptionally noble bearing, and a majestic, imposing form. Only one who outwardly displays the aura of a king is worthy to ride this steed.
以西域乌孙国良马为名，神骏而深具耐力。汉代文献记载其最早被冠以天马称号，后因大宛汗血马的引入改称西极马。

Named after the fine horses of the Wusun kingdom in the Western Regions, spirited and possessing great endurance. Han dynasty records note it was the first to be granted the epithet of ‘Heavenly Horse’, later renamed ‘Horse of the Western Extremity’ after the introduction of Dayuan's blood-sweating horses.
此马浑身上下浑然一色，通体雪白，没有半根杂毛。传说此马生下时只有脖子周围长毛，且性烈，犹如雄狮诞生一般，但长大后则会被赶出马群，后性格才会温顺。成马具有奇特气力，可踏雾登云不在话下。

This horse is uniformly snow-white all over, without a single stray hair. Legend has it that at birth it grew hair only around its neck and had a fierce temperament, like a newborn lion, only after being driven from the herd as it grew did its disposition turn gentle. As an adult, it possesses extraordinary strength, able to tread mist and mount clouds with ease.
又名乌骓，全身宛如通黑的丝绸一般，油光发亮，背长，腰短，只有四蹄雪白。相传此马极为护主，故民间又称其为义马，忠义人士方可驾驭。

Also known as Wuzhui, its body gleams like black silk, with a long back, short loin, and four snow-white hooves. Legend has it this horse is fiercely protective of its master, earning it the folk name ‘Righteous Steed’, only the loyal and righteous can ride it.
也作“白鹄”。毛发雪白的良驹。凭空虚跃，曹家白鹤。
Also written as ‘White Swan.’ A fine snow-white steed. Leaping through the air effortlessly, Cao's White Crane.
比通常黑马略显棕稚色，此马奔袭专注，不知疲倦，做冲锋战马最为适合。
Slightly more brown than a typical black horse, this mount charges with unwavering focus and tireless stamina, ideal as a charger.
荆襄地区的黄色战马，爆发力强。为黄忠在长沙时期的主要脚力。
A yellow warhorse from the Jingxiang region with explosive speed. Huang Zhong's primary mount during his time in Changsha.
通体银白，气质优雅，多用于日常出行与宴会代步。
Silver-white all over with an elegant bearing, commonly used for daily travel and banquet attendance.
疾驰如风，冲击力强，是三国名马之一。
Swift as the wind with powerful impact, one of the famed steeds of the Three Kingdoms.
出自东吴为数不多的名马，此马有言曰：驰骤烈风举帆之疾，故称之为惊帆。
One of the few famous horses from Eastern Wu. It is said of this horse: ‘It gallops with the speed of a sail catching a gale,’ hence called ‘Startled Sail’.
奔雷耐性高，性情温和，奔跑时声势如雷，蹄铁似有电光。奔驰与战场尤为突出其力大勇猛。

Galloping Thunder is even-tempered with great endurance, when running, its stride rumbles like thunder and sparks seem to flash from its iron shoes. Galloping across the battlefield, its immense strength and valor truly stand out.
相传为周穆王八骏之一后裔，通晓灵性。
Said to be a descendant of one of King Mu of Zhou's Eight Steeds, possessed of spiritual intelligence.
品种为来自西域大宛的大宛马，上等汗血宝马。
A purebred Ferghana horse from the Western Regions, a top-grade blood-sweating steed.
西凉名驹，骁勇善战。
A famous stallion from Xiliang, brave and battle-tested.
西域进贡的纯种汗血宝马，皮肤薄，血管可见，冲刺时如流血汗。
A purebred blood-sweating horse presented as tribute from the Western Regions, with thin skin and visible veins that appear to sweat blood at full gallop.
此马日行千里，奔驰时如追风逐电。
This horse covers a thousand li in a day, galloping as if chasing the wind and lightning.
毛发雪白，性情温顺，颇受文人雅客喜爱。
With a snow-white coat and gentle temperament, it is much loved by scholars and refined gentlemen.
据传此马为霸王的坐骑乌雅马的后裔，除此之外关于此马的信息无人知晓。
Said to be a descendant of the Conqueror's mount Wuya, but beyond this, nothing is known of this horse.
通体墨黑，鬃毛如刺，传说其奔袭时如暗夜麒麟，威慑力十足。
Jet-black all over with a bristle-like mane. Legend says it charges like a dark qilin, exuding tremendous menace.
通体火红的北方马，奔跑起来犹如燎原之火。
A fiery-red northern horse that runs like a prairie blaze.
跃于空中如同鸟禽，不禁使人称叹：凭空虚跃，唯有白鸽。
When it leaps through the air like a bird, one cannot help but exclaim: soaring from nothing, only the White Dove.
失去活力的老马，速度远不如当年。
An old horse that has lost its vigor, far slower than in its prime.
虽然勉强能作为代步工具，实际上更适合运输货物。
Though barely serviceable as transport, it is actually better suited for hauling cargo.
来自乌丸部族的战马，其骑兵被誉为 “天下名骑” 。
A warhorse from the Wuhuan tribe, whose cavalry are hailed as ‘the finest riders under heaven’.
一种高三尺的矮种马，可在果树下行走，常作为贡品或宫廷玩赏。
A pony standing three chi tall, able to walk under fruit trees, often presented as tribute or kept as a palace curiosity.
幽州边地的草原马，体型不高但耐力极佳，擅长途奔袭。
A steppe horse from the borderlands of You Province, not tall but with exceptional endurance, excelling at long-distance raids.
西南山地专用马，身材矮小但攀山耐力极强，适配剑阁、南中一带的崎岖地形。
A mountain horse from the southwest, small but with outstanding climbing endurance, suited to the rugged terrain around Jiange and Nanzhong.
